Erik works in the warehouse of a large supermarket in the United States. Erik is the developer of "The Endless Empty" and "A Chamber of Stars". zh.title: 首次展示针对 Microsoft Copilot for Word 的基于文档的自我传播 AI 蠕虫
zh.summary: 微软已将生成式 AI 助手 Copilot 集成到其 Word 和 Excel 等办公软件套件中。安全研究人员 Haakon Moray 首次证明了一种名为“AI Worm”的新型基于文档的自我传播恶意软件的有效性，该恶意软件针对的是 Copilot for Word。阅读更多...

en.title: Document-based self-propagating AI worm targeting Microsoft's Copilot for Word is demonstrated for the first time
en.summary: Microsoft has integrated Copilot, a generative AI assistant, into its office suite of office software such as Word and Excel. Security researcher Haakon Moray has demonstrated for the first time the effectiveness of a new document-based self-propagating malware called ``AI Worm'' that targets Copilot for Word. read more...

items.title: 脳は「真のマルチタスク」を実現するために再配線できるとの研究結果
items.summary: 人間の脳は意識的な判断を必要とする2つの課題に同時並行で取り組む時、複数のタスクを同時処理する「マルチタスク」ではなく、タスク間を素早く切り替えて処理していると考えられてきました。アメリカ・ジョージタウン大学のマキシミリアン・リーゼンフーバー氏や、リーハイ大学のパトリック・コックス氏らの研究チームは、1つの課題を長期間練習した時に脳内の処理経路と同時作業の能力がどう変わるのかを調べました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 研究结果表明大脑可以重新连接以实现“真正的多任务处理”
zh.summary: 人们认为，当人脑并行处理两项需要有意识判断的任务时，它会在任务之间快速切换，而不是“多任务处理”，即同时处理多个任务。由乔治城大学的马克西米利安·里森胡贝尔和理海大学的帕特里克·考克斯领导的研究小组调查了长时间练习单一任务时大脑中的处理路径和执行同时任务的能力如何变化。阅读更多...

en.title: Research results show that the brain can be rewired to achieve 'true multitasking'
en.summary: It has been thought that when the human brain tackles two tasks that require conscious judgment in parallel, it quickly switches between tasks rather than ``multitasking,'' processing multiple tasks simultaneously. A research team led by Maximilian Riesenhuber of Georgetown University and Patrick Cox of Lehigh University investigated how the processing pathways in the brain and the ability to perform simultaneous tasks change when practicing a single task for a long period of time. read more...

items.summary: 魚は古くから人間にとって重要な食糧源となっており、世界中のさまざまな狩猟採集民によって捕獲されていました。新たに、7000年前のノルウェーの狩猟採集民が山の上の孤立した湖に魚を運び込み、わなで捕獲していたことが明らかになりました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 原来，7000年前，狩猎采集者将鱼放入高山湖泊作为食物来源，并用木制陷阱捕获它们。
zh.summary: 自古以来，鱼类一直是人类重要的食物来源，并被世界各地的各种狩猎采集者猎杀。一项新的研究表明，7000 年前，挪威的狩猎采集者将鱼带到偏僻的高山湖泊，并用陷阱捕获它们。阅读更多...

en.title: It turns out that hunter-gatherers 7,000 years ago released fish into mountain lakes as a food source and captured them with wooden traps.
en.summary: Fish have been an important food source for humans since ancient times, and were hunted by various hunter-gatherers around the world. A new study reveals that 7,000 years ago, Norwegian hunter-gatherers brought fish to isolated mountain lakes and caught them in traps. read more...

ZGM is based on the real-time OS Zephyr RTOS, and aims to enable low-latency input processing and flexible customization according to hardware. Official release is scheduled for the first quarter of 2027. read more...

en.title: Telegram founder Pavel Durov is charged by Russia's Federal Security Service with aiding and abetting terrorist activities, alleging that Ukrainian spies were using Telegram to organize attacks in Russia
en.summary: Russian authorities announced on July 29, 2026 that they had charged Pavel Durov, the founder and CEO of the messaging app Telegram, with supporting terrorism. The Russian Federal Security Service (FSB) said, ``Telegram did not remove numerous channels and bots allegedly used to prepare and coordinate sabotage, acts of terrorism, and cyber fraud within Russia, resulting in numerous human casualties.'' read more...

en.title: ChatGPT and Roblox exceed 45 million monthly users in EU, designated as "ultra-large platform"

This is a measure that comes as the number of monthly users in the EU for both companies exceeds 45 million, and if they receive the designation, they will be required to submit transparency reports.
